chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, when he prepared to go to Makkah, would say to his family:
"Beware of placing in our provisions anything of perfume, nor saffron, that we may eat it or feed it to others."

key_terms.نُطْعِمُهُ: that we may feed it to others

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام instruct his family about scented provisions when traveling to Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام when preparing for travel to Makkah, instructing his household not to include scented items such as perfume or saffron in their provisions. It reflects the legal restraints observed in the state connected with hajj and iḥrām, especially regarding fragrant substances.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2660 - It is reported that Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (as) used to say to his family when preparing for a journey to Makkah:
"Be cautious not to include anything scented, such as perfume or saffron, in our provisions, whether for us to eat or to serve to others."
